where: crates/blaze-memo/src/keep.rs keep/keep_slice/keep_iter/keep_str; crates/hir-ty-borrowck/src/lib.rs BorrowckResult, crates/hir-ty-matchck/src/lib.rs MatchCheck, crates/hir-ty-wfcheck/src/lib.rs WfResult
what: A query value must own nothing that drops, but the only way to make the borrowed form (`keep_*`) panics outside a query run and requires `T: 'static`. Values that tests, a store read-back (`WfResultRef::to_result`) or a walker build outside a run, and values whose elements borrow `'db`, cannot be ported to arena slices mechanically, so the lane left them owned and they will trip the `!needs_drop` assert at monomorphization, which `cargo check` does not run.
cost: three analysis value trees (borrowck, match check, wfcheck) left unported, each needing a decision; the gate (`cargo check`) cannot see the failure
cause: a value's arena is reachable only through the running query's frame, not from the memo or a caller-owned arena, and the no-drop check is a post-monomorphization const assert
class: an allocation API usable only in one execution context, while the same type is built in several
prevention: make `keep_*` take an explicit arena (the run's, or a caller's for tests and read-backs) with `T: 'db`, and check no-drop at the `tracked` attribute's expansion (a trait bound on the value) so `cargo check` reports it
workaround: values built outside a run stay owned and are listed in the lane report
